title: Killa Banana Ice Nic Pouches - 13.2mg / pouch
description: Killa Banana Ice Nicotine Pouches offer a balanced nicotine experience with a sweet and refreshing blend of ripe banana given a cool icy finish. Each pouch contains 13.2mg of nicotine, making it suitable for adult users who prefer a satisfying yet measured nicotine release. The Banana Ice flavour provides a unique combination of creamy sweetness and frosty cool, delivering a smooth, long-lasting and enjoyable taste. These pouches are entirely tobacco-free, offering a clean and convenient alternative to traditional nicotine products. The discreet design of Killa Banana Ice pouches makes them ideal for use in various settings, whether you're on the move, at work, or in a social environment where traditional nicotine use isn’t possible. Killa Nicotine Pouches are crafted to deliver consistency and quality, ensuring a reliable and smooth nicotine experience. Simply place a pouch between your upper lip and gum and enjoy a steady release of nicotine for up to 30 minutes. With 20 pouches per pack, Killa Banana Ice offers a practical and flavoursome option for those who enjoy a cool, fruity twist while relieving nicotine cravings. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a steady nicotine release for up to 30min. 2 Place the used nicotine pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch.
